tagline: Building things, finishing them, and writing down what is next.
about: This is my corner of the web. Public pages cover who I am and what I have finished. Everything else is private: my goals, my dreamboard, my schedule, and a log of what I have done.
I keep it current by telling Claude what I did and what is coming up, and the site updates itself.

projects.title: Coffee Menu and Ordering Site
projects.role: Designed and built, for a friend's coffee business
projects.summary: A mobile-first website where customers see the menu with prices and order ahead for pickup, and the owner runs the shop from a sign-in. Customers choose a pickup time so drinks are made fresh, and pay when they collect.
highlights: Menu with prices that the owner edits after signing in, with no code needed
Online ordering with a pickup ETA, payment at pickup
A phone notification to the owner for every new order
Open and closed button for the owner, so customers always see the current status
QR code that opens the site on any phone
